fluff.overview: Manei Domini infantry squads operate in small, heavily augmented formations where every trooper carries cybernetic enhancements tailored to their combat role, from enhanced optics and communicator implants to dermal armor and prosthetic weapon mounts. Domini foot infantry operate as small, self-contained kill teams whose cybernetic enhancements compensate for their reduced squad sizes. Each trooper carries augmentations that make them individually more dangerous than a full squad of conventional soldiers. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
